title: chenopodium album var. subaphyllum
intro: Chenopodium album var. subaphyllum, commonly known as 'Lamb's quarters', is a plant species in the family Amaranthaceae. This plant is known to provide various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, sore throats, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Chenopodium album var. subaphyllum include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its medicinal uses. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
